channel.title: Shrek the Halls
channel.desc: Hoping to have a nice, quiet holiday with Fiona and the children, Shrek goes in search of advice and buys a book on having a nice holiday. He tries his best to follow the guidelines in the book; however, the book's list does not allow for the invasion of Donkey and all the rest of Shrek's swamp pals.
